checks.lead: Arthur Asher Miller (October 17, 1915 – February 10, 2005) was an American playwright and essayist. Among his most popular plays are All My Sons (1947), Death of a Salesman (1949), The Crucible (1953), and A View from the Bridge (1955). He wrote several screenplays, including The Misfits (1961). His drama Death of a Salesman is considered one of the best American plays of the 20th century.
